---
name: Feature request
about: A new patch, subcommand, or patcher capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What can't you do today without this?

## Proposal

New patch (what behavior, which bundle surface, default on or off?) or new
capability (which subcommand, what would it run?).

## Setting-or-env check

Patches are justified only when no settings/env lever exists for the same
behavior. What did you check, and why doesn't the official knob suffice?

## Willing to contribute it?

Start with the `new-patch` scaffold and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
